##### Project general facts

Victoria Palms is a gated townhouse community developed by Reportage Group, one of the largest private international developers, active across the Middle East, Europe and now East Africa. Conceived under the theme "Connect to Disconnect," the project blends contemporary architecture with Italian-inspired design across a collection of low-rise townhouses set within a landscaped, gated enclave. Each home is designed with a private rooftop terrace and jacuzzi, ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom, a dedicated maid's room, private parking and generous balconies and terraces for outdoor living.

Residents enjoy a full suite of communal amenities, including a swimming pool with a dedicated kids' pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, a clubhouse with a multipurpose hall, a lounge terrace and café, and private green spaces set aside for quiet relaxation. The gated entrance is secured around the clock, giving the community a strong sense of privacy alongside its shared facilities.

The townhouses are delivered unfurnished, with a full, high-end finish throughout. Interiors carry Italian craftsmanship in their detailing, with designer kitchens featuring custom cabinetry and premium countertops, fully tiled bathrooms with elegant fixtures, and refined touches such as built-in storage and full-length mirrors that give each home a polished, move-in-ready shell.

##### Location description and benefits

Victoria Palms occupies a lakeside setting in Entebbe, on the shores of Lake Victoria — the largest lake in Africa and a natural meeting point between Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania. The community sits close to the city's key destinations, including Kitubulu Forest and Beach, Victoria Mall and the lake shoreline itself, placing residents close to nature while remaining connected to everyday city life.

Everyday infrastructure is easily reached on foot or by a short drive, with the Entebbe Sailing Club, the Entebbe Golf Club, the Entebbe Zoo and Botanical Garden, and Nkumba University all nearby. Entebbe International Airport is also within easy driving distance, making the location convenient for both daily life and international travel.

Foreign buyers in Uganda acquire property through a registered leasehold interest, fully transferable, inheritable and bankable. Entebbe's growing profile as a lakeside residential and tourism destination, combined with its proximity to the airport and its established expatriate community, supports steady demand for well-finished homes in gated communities of this kind.
